commands.command: independent bundled TypeScript verification via esbuild + node

metrics.mean_zero_handling: explicit: zero mean with zero standard deviation yields ratio 0; nonzero deviation yields Infinity

exactly_60_unique_ubs_indicator_combinat.evidence: Independent grouping reported 60 distinct ubsId/indicatorId keys

each_series_has_exactly_12_unique_contin.evidence: All groups have 12 records, 12 unique months, and exact expected inclusive range 2025-07..2026-06

valid_references_to_15_ubs_and_4_indicat.evidence: All record IDs resolve against ubsList and indicatorsList; observed 15 UBS IDs and 4 indicator IDs

finite_nonnegative_values_within_130_per.evidence: Every value passed Number.isFinite, >= 0, and <= matching indicator.meta * 1.3

population_stddev_at_most_15_percent_of_.evidence: Worst observed population standard-deviation/mean ratio was 0.0335150731 (3.3515%), below 15%; zero-mean case handled explicitly

history_record_type_conformance.evidence: history.ts imports HistoryRecord and returns HistoryRecord[]; fields are ubsId, indicatorId, mes, valor with valid indicator union

deterministic_data_and_order.evidence: Generation uses fixed months, stable ubsList order, indicatorsList order, and arithmetic deterministicOffset; two independent executions produced identical SHA-256 output

runtime_generation_without_randomness_cu.evidence: history.ts contains no Math.random, Date/new Date, time-dependent API, or array mutation; createHistory executes once at import and produces fresh records

export_mutability_assessment.evidence: No mutation occurs during generation/import. historyData is typed as HistoryRecord[] (not readonly), so downstream consumers could intentionally mutate the export; this is an API hardening observation, not an observed runtime mutation or TASK-010 acceptance failure
